/events/pokemon-go-fest-2026-global-sund.title: GO Fest 2026 Sunday Raid Makeup
/events/pokemon-go-fest-2026-global-sund.description:
UPDATE from Scopely:

We previously announced a special GO Fest 2026: Global Sunday raid event in select regions. Upon further investigation, we have found that the impact of technical issues related to raids was more widespread than initially thought. Therefore, we will expand the event globally to include all Trainers. The event will take place on Sunday, July 26, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time.Additionally, we appreciate your extended patience as we work through these updates. As a token of our gratitude and sincere apology for the confusion we have caused, we have increased the number of free Raid Passes from 9 to 12 for this event.

As compensation for a technical issue that prevented some Trainers from joining Raid Battles during Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, a special Sunday raid makeup event will be held on July 26, 2026 from 10 am to 7 pm local time.

Raid Bosses featured during the original Sunday of GO Fest 2026: Global—including Mega Mewtwo Y Super Mega Raids—will appear!

/events/pokemon-go-fest-2026-global/.title: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global
/events/pokemon-go-fest-2026-global/.description:

For the first time, GO Fest: Global is free for all Trainers who log in during event weekend. Everyone can access the featured Special Research, event bonuses, and increased Shiny encounter opportunities at no cost.

/events/pokemon-go-fest-2026-mega-finale.description:
Rally with Trainers around the world for the mega conclusion of Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale brings rotating habitats, powerful Mega Raids, and Super Mega Raids featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y.

Prepare during the lead-up event Mega Ascension, then join this unticketed worldwide weekend finale.

The Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale event will take place from September 5, 2026 at 10 am to September 6, 2026 at 6 pm local time.

/events/shadow-giratina-altered-in-shado.title: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) in Shadow Raids
/events/shadow-giratina-altered-in-shado.description:
Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) will make its Shadow Raid debut in Pokémon GO! If you’re lucky you’ll be able to encounter Shiny Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme)!

Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) will appear in five-star Shadow Raids every weekend from August 5 to September 8.

/events/shadow-palkia-in-shadow-raids-ju.title: Shadow Palkia in Shadow Raids
/events/shadow-palkia-in-shadow-raids-ju.description:
Shadow Palkia will appear in Pokemon GO in Shadow Raids. If you’re lucky you’ll be able to encounter Shiny Shadow Palkia!

Shadow Palkia will appear in five-star Shadow Raids every weekend from July 1 to August 4.

/events/shadow-thundurus-incarnate-forme.title: Shadow Thundurus (Incarnate Forme) in Shadow Raids
/events/shadow-thundurus-incarnate-forme.description: Shadow Thundurus (Incarnate Forme) will appear in five-star Shadow Raids every weekend from September 9, 2026 to October 6, 2026. If you’re lucky, you may encounter Shiny Shadow Thundurus (Incarnate Forme)!

/events/uxie-mesprit-azelf-in-5-star-rai.title: Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf in 5-star Raid Battles
/events/uxie-mesprit-azelf-in-5-star-rai.description:
Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf will be in five-star raid battles from August 5, 2026 to August 11, 2026.

Raid Hours

There will also be a Raid Hour featuring Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf from 6:00 pm to 7:00 pm local time on the following date:

- August 5

As a reminder, these are the regions that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf are available in:

Uxie is available in the Asia-Pacific region.Mesprit is available in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India.Azelf is available in the Americas and Greenland.

/events/water-festival-2026/.title: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
/events/water-festival-2026/.description:

The Ultra Unlock: Water Festival event will take place from August 18, 2026 at 10 am to August 24, 2026 at 8 pm local time.

/events/xurkitree-pheromosa-buzzwole-in-.title: Xurkitree, Pheromosa, and Buzzwole in 5-star Raid Battles
/events/xurkitree-pheromosa-buzzwole-in-.description:
Xurkitree, Pheromosa, and Buzzwole will be in five-star raid battles from September 23, 2026 to September 29, 2026.

Xurkitree will appear in the Asia-Pacific region, Pheromosa will appear in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India, and Buzzwole will appear in the Americas and Greenland.

Raid Hours

There will also be a Raid Hour featuring these regional raid bosses from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time on September 23.
